title: Subtyped arrays only accept another subtyped array
body:
### Tested versions

Only tested on v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f]

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 31.0.101.5522) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1135G7 @ 2.40GHz (8 threads) - 11.78 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When a subtyped array (foo:Array[bool]), for example) is set directly to another, even a duplicated one with correct values, it errors in runtime unless the assigned array has the same subtype.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a subtyped array, and try to set its value with = (as opposed to clear()ing it and appending_array, for example)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

As text, as it's only a few lines. Note that these do not error in editor, and the stated reasoning is "Trying to assign an array of type "Array" to a variable of type "Array[{type}]".

```gdscript
extends Node2D
var testarr1 := [1]
var testarr2  = [1]
var typedtestarr1:Array[int]=[1]
var typedtestarr2:Array[int]=[1]

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	typedtestarr1 = [1]
	typedtestarr1 = testarr1 ##Probably correct that these error
	typedtestarr1 = testarr2 ##Probably correct that these error
	typedtestarr1 = typedtestarr2 ##Does not error, but the others do
	typedtestarr1 = [1].duplicate() ##But none of these should
	typedtestarr1 = testarr1.duplicate() ##But none of these should
	typedtestarr1 = testarr2.duplicate() ##But none of these should
	typedtestarr1 = typedtestarr2.duplicate() ##Does not error, but the others do
